layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Troodon 'Smart Brain' morphology
features: A friendly green clay Troodon head with a very tall, rounded forehead
The top of the head is made of translucent, glowing blue 'jelly clay'
Inside the glow are soft, spiraling clay 'thought swirls' representing a large brain
The dinosaur has a clever, knowing smile and one large, sparkly eye looking upward
Soft ambient occlusion shadows where the glowing brain meets the green clay skin
layer_3_action.action: A centered, cinematic macro shot of the 'Smart' morphology. The glow from the head softly lights up the dinosaur's face. It looks magical and friendly, not scientific. No text.
